description.en: The durable daily sales cube: one row per venue-day of the orders that LEFT the hot log at a rotation (orders, refusals, takings, food sales, kinds, orders and takings by hour, channels, and per dish portions, food sales and the cost stamped at sale). A cache with a verifier, never a source (operator approved 2026-10-03, against fold.rs 'NO ANALYTICS STORE'). POST folds every archive not yet folded (the back-fill; the rotation calls the same catch-up); on the QA hub only, rotateAsOf first rotates as of that instant.
description.uk: Довговічний денний куб продажів: історія понад 30 днів, перевірювана проти архівів байт у байт.

image_format: head line {"v":1,"folded":[archive ids]} then one JSON line per day {"d":yyyymmdd,"o","x","t","f","k":[3],"h":[24],"ht":[24],"c":{channel:[orders,took]},"m":{dish:[qty,food,stamped_qty,stamped_cost]},"src":[archive ids]}, oldest first; integer minor units; no person

rotateAsOf.description: QA hub only (403 elsewhere): rotate as if it were this instant (ms) before folding

rebuild.description: start from an empty cube and fold every archive again
